title: OS Shell
description: 🧬️ `os.shell` — every shell wire type the pure reduce() transition consumes and produces. This document is the authority: the Rust registry in `🦀️.rs` carries exactly one row per `$defs` export and renders `../🤖️generated/🟦️.ts` from it, and `🟦️.ts` parses against this document. Every field is required and nullability is spelled out, exactly as the TypeScript mirror declares it.

Anchor.title: Anchor
Anchor.description: 🧭️ The four docking edges a panel can attach to.

AppRole.title: AppRole
AppRole.description: 🎭️ Which role group the Open panel focuses. Transparent newtype over a plain string.

ByAnchor.title: ByAnchor
ByAnchor.description: 🧭️ One value per Anchor. Generic in Rust/TypeScript (`ByAnchor<T>`); the item contract is refined at each use site, so the four edges are declared here without a value type.

left.description: Value docked to the left edge.

right.description: Value docked to the right edge.

top.description: Value docked to the top edge.

bottom.description: Value docked to the bottom edge.

Conflict.title: Conflict
Conflict.description: ⚠️ One open conflict on the roster.

DialogState.title: DialogState
DialogState.description: 🪟️ One entry on the open-dialog stack.

seedArgs.description: Free-form dialog seed payload; any JSON value, including null.

DockUiState.title: DockUiState
DockUiState.description: 🗂️ Restored dock UI state — a layout tree plus per-anchor visibility.

params.description: Free-form window seed payload; any JSON value, including null.

IconName.title: IconName
IconName.description: 🖼️ Stable icon identifier. Transparent newtype over a plain string.

InferencePortPhase.title: InferencePortPhase
InferencePortPhase.description: 💡️ The complete rendered lifecycle of one host-owned ephemeral inference port; the last four are terminal.

InferencePortStatus.title: InferencePortStatus
InferencePortStatus.description: 💡️ Ephemeral per-document inference-port state. Never persisted.

LayoutNode.title: LayoutNode
LayoutNode.description: 🧱️ Recursive window/dock layout tree — window ids at the leaves, nested splits above them.

ShellCapability.title: ShellCapability
ShellCapability.description: 🛰️ One machine-readable descriptor per ShellCommand variant — what an MCP gateway compiles into its tool catalog.

schema.description: JSON Schema for this variant's payload, derived from ShellCommand.

ShellCommand.title: ShellCommand
ShellCommand.description: 🎮️ The vocabulary the LLM (and every other shell client) speaks. Declaration order matches SHELL_COMMAND_CATALOG, which stamps each variant's ShellCapability id.

value.description: Free-form staged argument value; any JSON value.
Free-form staged argument value; any JSON value.

size.description: Requested panel size. A negative or non-finite request is representable here and rejected by reduce() with ShellError.invalidPanelSize.

seedArgs.description: Free-form dialog seed payload; any JSON value, including null.

ShellError.title: ShellError
ShellError.description: 🚨️ Why a command was rejected. reduce() never panics.

ShellEvent.title: ShellEvent
ShellEvent.description: 📣️ What reduce() reports happened. `applied` is emitted exactly once, last, for every accepted command.

ShellScope.title: ShellScope
ShellScope.description: 💾️ Storage backend for shell state persistence.

ShellState.title: ShellState
ShellState.description: 📋️ The shell's entire semantic UI state — the single source of truth. Render caches are deliberately absent. `revision` increments on every successfully applied ShellCommand.

additionalProperties.description: Free-form staged argument value; any JSON value.
Free-form staged argument value; any JSON value.

SplitOrientation.title: SplitOrientation
SplitOrientation.description: 🧱️ How the child regions of a split are arranged.

UiLocale.title: UiLocale
UiLocale.description: 🌐️ Interface language. English first, then German; a host MUST make an explicit choice — there is no default language.

UiPreferences.title: UiPreferences
UiPreferences.description: ⚙️ Persisted local-only OS UI preferences. Null selected values mean the user has not chosen a value yet.
